How the click speed test works

  1. Choose a test duration. The default test lasts 5 seconds.
  2. Press the test area with your left mouse button or tap with one finger. Your first press starts the timer and counts toward your score.
  3. Keep pressing until time runs out. Compare your result with your personal best or try again.

How is CPS calculated?

CPS stands for clicks per second. Divide the total number of presses counted in a completed run by the test duration.

47 clicks ÷ 5 seconds = 9.40 CPS

Which test duration should I choose?

Use 1 second for a quick burst, 5 or 10 seconds to compare short runs, or 30 seconds to see how long you can keep your pace.

Compare attempts on the same device and at the same duration. The test keeps separate personal bests for mouse and touch. Switching tabs cancels the current run.
